responsibility.value: Enqueues rental notification messages into the outbox table by constructing RentalStatusChanged messages with locale-specific Croatian title/body text and serializing them as outbox rows, without persisting them (the caller owns SaveChanges).

Owns: Building a RentalStatusChanged message with recipient/actor IDs, rental details, and human-readable Croatian title/body for newly created rental requests (DispatchCreatedAsync)

Building a RentalStatusChanged message with recipient/actor IDs, rental details, and trigger-specific Croatian title/body for state transitions (DispatchTransitionAsync — handles Approve, Reject, Pickup, Complete, Cancel, ReturnEarly, and unknown triggers via a default fallback)
Serializing the message to JSON (JsonSerializerDefaults.Web) and creating an unpersisted RentalNotificationOutbox entity via EnqueueOutbox
Conditionally omitting the rejection reason from the notification body when rental.Note is null or whitespace (Reject trigger arm)
doesNotOwn: Calling SaveChangesAsync to persist the outbox row — this is delegated entirely to the caller's unit of work or transaction boundary
Publishing messages to the message broker — the outbox row is consumed later by RentalNotificationOutboxPublisher, a separate BackgroundService
Logging — the class has no ILogger unlike the Publisher; serialization/DB failures surface as raw exceptions to the caller with no dedicated log trail
Error handling — the class does not wrap any operation in try/catch; exceptions propagate directly to the caller
Determining who should receive the notification — recipient IDs (studentUserId, actorUserId) are supplied by the caller and placed verbatim into the message

collaborators.detail: Injected via constructor; used in EnqueueOutbox to call Set<RentalNotificationOutbox>().Add(entry)
Injected via constructor; provides clock.UtcNow as the OccurredAt timestamp in every RentalStatusChanged message
Received as a parameter in both public methods; properties like Id, InstrumentModel, StoreName, RentalStatus, Fee, Note, StudentUserId are read to populate the outbound notification
Received as a parameter in DispatchTransitionAsync; switched over to select the appropriate notification title/body
Constructs a new RentalStatusChanged instance in both public methods, populated with rental data and locale-specific text, then serializes it to JSON
Creates a new RentalNotificationOutbox entity with the serialized JSON as PayloadJson and adds it to the DbSet
Implements the 2-method interface (DispatchCreatedAsync, DispatchTransitionAsync) that defines the notification enqueue contract

contracts: DispatchCreatedAsync always produces a notification with title 'Zahtjev za iznajmljivanje poslan' and a body mentioning the instrument model and store name

DispatchTransitionAsync produces trigger-specific notification text for each known RentalTrigger value (Approve includes the monthly fee; Reject conditionally includes the reason; Pickup/Complete/Cancel/ReturnEarly have fixed texts)
For any unknown RentalTrigger value, the switch default arm produces a generic title 'Status iznajmljivanja promijenjen' without crashing
The Reject arm never crashes on null/whitespace Note — it conditionally omits the reason text via string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace check
EnqueueOutbox always creates a new RentalNotificationOutbox entity with non-null PayloadJson and adds it to the DbSet; it never calls SaveChangesAsync
assumptions: The caller will call SaveChangesAsync after invoking this dispatcher — if the caller forgets, the outbox row never reaches the database and the notification is silently lost with no exception or log

InstrumentRentalDto properties used in message construction (Id, InstrumentModel, StoreName, Fee, etc.) are non-null and have valid values — null model names or zero IDs are accepted without validation
The caller manages its own transaction scope — this class does not begin or commit any database transaction
invariants: All RentalStatusChanged messages are constructed with a non-null OccurredAt timestamp from clock.UtcNow
The message's studentActorId in DispatchCreatedAsync is always the studentUserId parameter (the student is both the subject and the initiator of the creation event)
The message's studentActorId in DispatchTransitionAsync is always the actorUserId parameter (distinct from the rental's owner StudentUserId)
failureModes: Silent notification loss if the caller never calls SaveChangesAsync — no exception is thrown and no record exists to indicate the notification was dropped at the application level
JsonSerializer.Serialize exception propagates raw to the caller — no catch block exists in EnqueueOutbox
DbSet.Add exception propagates raw to the caller — no catch block exists in EnqueueOutbox

A new RentalTrigger enum value added without updating the switch produces a generic, uninformative notification title — the default arm catches all values but provides no specific guidance to the end user about what happened
architecturalNotes: The SaveChanges delegation is a deliberate architectural choice (thin enqueuer pattern), but the lack of a guard or warning means a developer who is unaware of this contract could silently lose notifications in a new code path
Unlike RentalNotificationOutboxPublisher, this class has no logging — failures surface only as caller-side exceptions with no dedicated audit trail for debugging notification delivery issues
The switch default arm is defensive against new enum values, but the generic message it produces (no reference to the actual trigger name) makes it a poor experience for future extension
